description: Kometa, a living comet, a blazing white-hot head of fire and ice with a fierce face and glowing eyes, a long streaming tail of orange flames and sparks curving behind it, flying diagonally, an omen of doom, a bold simple silhouette filling the whole picture, few big readable shapes, strong light and dark contrast, a crisp dark outline, little fine detail, menacing, full body, the comet alone, no stars, no ground, no background, the whole comet inside the picture, the tail too
